counterexample.fixed_base: r0=2, K_2=30; f0=exp(2*pi*i*Phi/5); Phi is the unique signed plaquette link sum.
counterexample.source_decomposition: L_r f_r=lambda_r f_r+e_r, lambda_r in {-10-2 sqrt(5),-10+2 sqrt(5)}, sup |e_r|<=256/K_r. Full original rates and roots retained.
counterexample.full_dynamics: D(L_r)=C^(Omega_r). Finite row-generator Poisson expansion establishes sup contraction for all original PH/TR/LK/AP roots; no eigenfunction-span invariance.
counterexample.uniform_time_estimate: ||S_r(t)f_r-exp(lambda_r*t)f_r||_infinity<=256*t/K_r for every t>=0, by the exact finite-vector Duhamel identity.
counterexample.pair_bound: For a flip pair, pointwise defect at t=1/10 >= 2 exp(-1) sinh(sqrt(5)/5) - (256/10)(1/K_r+1/K_s) >= 4/15-1/15=1/5 if K_s>=K_r>=768.
counterexample.tail_construction: Given R, let m=max(R,4), B=p_(m+1), P=product_(p<=B,p!=5)p, t=P^(-1) mod5 in {1,2,3,4}. Every prime factor of 1+tP exceeds B; at least one q=p_k is 2 or 3 mod5. Choose r=k-2>=m and s=r+1.
counterexample.quantifier: For every R choose r>=max(R,4), s=r+1 by the elementary prime-tail argument; K_r>=2310>768. Thus the supremum in the original target is >=1/5 for every R and every T>=1/10.
